q: How do I calculate the carbon footprint of bone china or porcelain tableware per piece?
title: Bone china tableware carbon per piece
short: Add the kiln fuel for the biscuit, glaze and decoration firings at its default factor and the plant electricity at 0.710 kg CO2 per kWh, divide by good pieces, then add the clay body, glaze, decals and packaging from supplier data. Rejects raise the figure per good piece.
audience: Tableware makers, hotel suppliers and exporters

ul: Biscuit firing of the shaped body.
Decoration firing for decals or gold lines, if used.

p: Divide by pieces that pass inspection, not pieces loaded. A higher reject rate means more fuel per good piece, so firing yield is a direct carbon lever.
Plates, cups and bowls differ in weight. If the plant reports per kilogram, a buyer can convert to pieces from the piece weight.
